Class SolverSingleOpen

java.lang.Object
solvers.Solver
solvers.singleSolverAlgorithms.SolverSingleOpen
public class SolverSingleOpen extends Solver
Solves a single class open model.
To read about the formulas used to solve the system, see:
E.D. Lazowska, J. Zahorjan, G.S. Graham, K. Sevcik
Quantitative System Performance,
Prentice Hall, 1984
 NOT USED
Author:
Federico Granata, Stefano Omini
